purpose: Machine-readable change-to-evidence map for PATH release qualification.

inventory-contract.description: Validate this inventory, domain dependencies, source coverage, and command references.

candidate-source-stability.description: Re-fingerprint admin, portal, and shared after all checks and reject any test/build source mutation.
candidate-source-stability.cleanup: None; a changed tree is a blocker and must be restored intentionally before rerun.

admin-aggregate.description: All maintained admin frontend, backend, authorization, composition, concurrency, and tooling suites.
admin-aggregate.effects: No environment mutation; test-only injected dependencies.

portal-aggregate.description: All maintained portal frontend, auth, notification, route, signing, and full-stack suites.
portal-aggregate.effects: No environment mutation; test-only injected dependencies.

privacy-route-static.description: Route-aware static object-scope tripwire with deliberate-removal self-tests.

real-mysql-schema-preflight.description: Metadata-only exact DEV identity plus one-object-at-a-time DDL, full-column, index, and constraint proof before any ordinary release-contract SQL.
real-mysql-schema-preflight.effects: Metadata queries only; zero runtime-readiness reads, transactions, fixtures, or cleanup SQL.
real-mysql-schema-preflight.cleanup: None; a failure blocks GO. Later SQL-bearing checks independently repeat fail-closed preflight and cannot execute ordinary SQL when it fails.

schema-plan-dev.description: Canonical migration ledger/checksum plan after exact DEV identity and full optional-ledger DDL proof.
schema-plan-dev.effects: Metadata-only preflight plus one live-schema-guarded, fully qualified ledger SELECT when the ledger exists; never creates the ledger.

real-mysql-contract.description: Exact DEV identity/full-object schema guard, guarded runtime readiness/helpers, authenticated staff hydration, import claim, worker-delivery persistence, rollback, and residue proof.
real-mysql-contract.effects: Runs metadata-only identity/DDL/column/index/constraint preflight first, then creates synthetic rows through the per-statement guard inside one DEV transaction and rolls it back.
real-mysql-contract.cleanup: After mutation begins, rollback and every zero-row residue assertion are mandatory even when the fixture fails; before mutation, schema failure closes without cleanup SQL.

admin-build.description: Compile the current admin TEST-target bundle into an isolated temporary directory.
admin-build.cleanup: Restores generated build metadata and removes temporary build output.

portal-build.description: Compile the current portal TEST-target bundle into an isolated temporary directory.
portal-build.cleanup: Restores generated build metadata and removes temporary build output.

admin-browser-suite.description: Real compiled admin bundle: shell, queues, intake authoring, workspace, assessment, intervention, network-idle, failure, and role/state assertions.
admin-browser-suite.effects: Local deterministic browser traffic with intercepted APIs; no database or external send.
admin-browser-suite.cleanup: Closes browser/server, restores build metadata, and removes temporary build output.

privacy-erm-db.description: Read-only real-DEV relational integrity and privacy constraint checks.

payment-db-rollback.effects: Synthetic DEV payment fixture inside one transaction; no provider or email call.

intacct-local-contract.description: PATH/local-mock drift guard; explicitly not Sage certification.

ai-guidance-contract.description: Admin AI high-risk guidance fixture shape contract; no external model call.

test-deployment-provenance.description: Require a successful TEST deploy manifest whose source, schema and release match the DEV-qualified candidate.

test-rollback-readiness.description: Require each deployed TEST app to record a distinct retained prior artifact before replacement.
test-rollback-readiness.effects: Read-only deployment-manifest validation; artifact discovery occurred before deploy upload.
test-rollback-readiness.cleanup: None. Retain both candidate and rollback artifacts until PROD authorization expires.

test-target-health.description: Every registered TEST admin/portal target is healthy under normal ALB forwarding.

test-runtime-postflight.description: On-instance admin/portal readiness, authenticated-contract source, PM2, migration, worker, runtime-config, external-routing, and recent-error proof.
test-runtime-postflight.effects: Read-only AWS SSM and TEST database queries.
test-runtime-postflight.cleanup: No persistent remote runner; SSM command history is retained as operational evidence.

test-two-step-role-journeys.description: Deployed browser/API role journeys for Coordinator, Regional Manager and Decision Maker across assessment/proposal/revision workflows.
test-two-step-role-journeys.effects: Creates disposable TEST Cognito, DB, document, notification and object-store fixtures; no real email.
test-two-step-role-journeys.cleanup: Script must prove zero Cognito, DB, notification, document and object residue.

test-intake-completion.description: Published-workflow validation, completion transaction, retry/idempotency, generated files, and cleanup on deployed TEST.
test-intake-completion.effects: Creates disposable TEST applicant/Cognito/DB/object fixtures; no real email.
test-intake-completion.cleanup: Script must prove zero DB, Cognito and object residue.

test-cfa-signing.description: Authenticated deployed CFA completion using the live signing_request row shape, application lineage, generated PDF, version finalizer, event, idempotent retry, and cleanup.
test-cfa-signing.effects: Creates disposable TEST Cognito, DB and object-store fixtures; no email or provider call.
test-cfa-signing.cleanup: Script must prove zero DB, Cognito and generated-object residue.

test-applicant-scope-browser.description: Deployed portal browser/API rightful-vs-wrong-applicant access and safe summary behavior.
test-applicant-scope-browser.effects: Creates disposable TEST Cognito and relational fixtures; no real email.
test-applicant-scope-browser.cleanup: Script must prove Cognito and database fixture removal.

test-live-privacy-denials.description: Autonomously provision disposable real Cognito staff/applicant identities and relational fixtures, then run strict wrong-role/wrong-owner denials with no skips.
test-live-privacy-denials.effects: Creates disposable TEST Cognito, staff/applicant, case/application, document, message and payment fixtures; makes authenticated requests only; no real email or provider call.
test-live-privacy-denials.cleanup: Mandatory Cognito and database cleanup with zero-residue assertion; ephemeral tokens are never emitted into qualification evidence or logs.

test-payment-rollback.description: Run the deployed rollback-only payment fixture with email/provider routing disabled.
test-payment-rollback.effects: Synthetic TEST transaction only; no email or provider call.

test-maintenance-cleanup.description: Prove TEST warning/fallback are clear and both host rules use normal forwarding.

domains.description: Build, package, migration, maintenance, rollback and deployment control plane.
Canonical migrations, runtime schema assertions and readiness/request parity.
Cognito authentication, staff/applicant identity domains, role authorization and object scope.
Admin frontend route, state, network, queue and workspace behavior.
Public portal shell, renderer, draft, signing and applicant-facing network behavior.
Application assessment, action plan and intervention review state machines and artifacts.
Intake authoring, published runtime, portal renderer, completion and admin manual intake.
Durable runtime/publish configuration, feature flags, AI precedence and environment boundaries.
Events, reminders, queues, retry/dead-letter handling, notifications and background process startup.
Object storage, uploads, documents, generated files, secure messages and signing completion.
Payment packets, allocations, evidence, Finance handoff, follow-up and reconciliation.
Regional Snapshot application activity, approved funding, data-quality reporting, audit detail and offline pre-deployment exports.
Sage Intacct, SES, S3, Cognito and external AI contracts with safe substitutes or controlled proof.
Persistent project memory and runbook changes that do not alter a deployable surface.
